description.value:
Sawbones Practice operatives know the body from every angle, where a blade opens a wound, and exactly how to close one again after. That dual mastery makes them uniquely dangerous and uniquely valuable, able to drop a target with surgical precision and then patch up a squadmate minutes later.

Untroubled by squeamishness, they chase medical knowledge wherever it leads, however unsavory the source. On the battlefield that expertise cuts both ways: healing allies fast enough to keep the fight going, and finding exactly the wound that ends it.
